verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API that covers everything the dashboard can do, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation policy. A probe for an OpenAPI spec also returned 404 on every candidate path, so no documented versioned contract is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
